stories.title: Devo expands to 23 stores in New Delhi
stories.summary: Siyaram Silk Mills Ltd. has opened its 23rd Devo store in Karol Bagh, New Delhi. The brand describes its offerings as contemporary men’s occasion wear and premium ethnic attire. The company reports strong immediate market traction at the new location, which sits in a high-traffic wedding shopping district.

stories.title: Shireen’s Boutique opens in Bandipora
stories.summary: Shireen’s Boutique has opened at Main Chowk in Bandipora, offering women’s clothing, accessories, and custom tailoring services. The store aims to address local demand for traditional and imported fashion. The inauguration was attended by local dignitaries and community members.

stories.title: Sunview Fashion Fiesta 2.0 held in Ludhiana
stories.summary: Actress Vaani Kapoor appeared as the showstopper for the Sunview Fashion Fiesta 2.0 in Ludhiana, Punjab. The event was organized by Sunview Plaza in collaboration with the Fashion Design Council of India. Models showcased various designs on the runway during the Saturday event.

stories.title: Sunview Fashion Fiesta 2.0 gallery
stories.summary: Actress Vaani Kapoor served as the showstopper for the Sunview Fashion Fiesta 2.0 in Ludhiana, Punjab. The event, organized by Sunview Plaza and the Fashion Design Council of India, featured runway presentations from various models on November 21, 2026.

stories.title: Kaziah Liz Mejo showcases Kerala at Miss Universe
stories.summary: India’s Miss Universe representative Kaziah Liz Mejo wore a Kerala-inspired ensemble during the pageant’s national costume round in Puerto Rico. Designed by House of Sidhant, the outfit aimed to celebrate India’s textile heritage and cultural identity through a blend of traditional fabrics and vibrant colours.

stories.title: Miss Universe India presents Kerala-inspired costume
stories.summary: Representing India at Miss Universe 2026, Kaziah Liz Mejo debuted a costume designed to highlight the country’s textile traditions. The ensemble combined various regional fabrics to showcase Indian craftsmanship. The pageant contestant is currently sharing her experience in Puerto Rico via social media.

stories.title: Inditex positions Lefties as a value alternative
stories.summary: Inditex is expanding its Lefties brand to capture consumers who find Zara prices prohibitive. Originally an outlet for unsold merchandise, Lefties now operates as a standalone value-fashion retailer. The company says its goal is to bring its design and retail capabilities to a broader, price-conscious audience.

stories.title: Designers revisit Indian handloom for winter
stories.summary: Designers are incorporating traditional Indian textiles like Pashmina, Khadi, and Eri silk into modern winter silhouettes. The trend emphasizes layering and tailoring to recontextualize native weaves. The industry suggests that while the textile carries the story, the silhouette provides a new voice.

stories.title: Fashion as a language in The Hunger Games
stories.summary: The Hunger Games franchise uses fashion to convey power, identity, and resistance within the society of Panem. Characters like Effie Trinket serve as examples of how clothing acts as a dominant language in the dystopian world, particularly when contrasting the Capitol with the impoverished districts.

stories.title: Miu Miu appoints Becky Armstrong as ambassador
stories.summary: Miu Miu has named Thai British actress Becky Armstrong as its latest brand ambassador. The brand stated that Armstrong’s presence reflects the spirit of the label, founded in 1993 by Miuccia Prada. Armstrong joins a roster of existing ambassadors including Gigi Hadid and Chloë Sevigny.

stories.title: Martine Rose named Balenciaga creative director
stories.summary: Kering has appointed British designer Martine Rose as creative director of Balenciaga, effective November 16, 2026. Rose succeeds Pierpaolo Piccioli, becoming the first woman to lead the house in its 109-year history. She is known for her two decades of work in menswear and subcultural influence.

stories.title: Rihanna and daughter star in Dior campaign
stories.summary: Rihanna and her 14-month-old daughter, Rocki, appear in the Lady Dior 2027 campaign. Photographed by Sam Rock, the pair are featured wearing matching black leather jackets. The billionaire beauty mogul continues to integrate her family into her luxury brand partnerships.

stories.title: Miley Cyrus Marries Maxx Morando in Long-Sleeve Silk Saint Laurent Wedding Dress - People.com
Miley Cyrus marries Maxx Morando
stories.summary: Miley Cyrus announced her marriage to Maxx Morando on November 22, 2026. The singer shared photos of the intimate California ceremony on Instagram, captioned with the date and the initials of the couple. Friends and industry peers have offered public congratulations.

stories.title: Felix fronts Hanbok Wave campaign
stories.summary: Stray Kids member Felix is the face of this year’s Hanbok Wave campaign. The initiative, led by the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, aims to promote traditional Korean attire through modern designs. Billboards featuring the campaign are appearing in New York, Seoul, and Paris.

stories.title: Mariah Carey stars in Gucci holiday campaign
stories.summary: Gucci has launched its 2026 holiday campaign featuring Mariah Carey. Directed by Harmony Korine, the short film depicts a hotel preparing for the singer's arrival. The campaign is set to her 1994 track, All I Want for Christmas Is You.

stories.title: Dior names Hyunjin as brand ambassador
stories.summary: Dior has appointed Stray Kids member Hyunjin as a brand ambassador. The South Korean performer will represent the luxury house’s beauty division and collections designed by Jonathan Anderson. The announcement coincides with the K-pop group's ongoing world tour.

stories.title: Paolo Bulgari dies aged 89
stories.summary: Paolo Bulgari, who served as chairman of the Bvlgari Group since 1984, has died at 89. The company described him as a true creative soul whose work would continue to inspire generations to come. He was the grandson of the firm's founder, Greek silversmith Sotirios Voulgaris.

stories.title: Paolo Bulgari, Architect of Jeweller’s Rise to Global Luxury Brand, Dies at 89 - The Business of Fashion
Paolo Bulgari, jewelry tycoon, dies at 89
stories.summary: Paolo Bulgari, the businessman who transformed his family's Roman jewelry house into a global luxury empire, has died at 89. His death was announced by his family on Saturday, prompting tributes from the international luxury industry and renewed attention to the dynasty's Greek roots.

stories.title: Bvlgari chairman Paolo Bulgari dies at 89
stories.summary: Paolo Bulgari, chairman of the luxury jewelry house since 1984, has died aged 89. The brand paid tribute to his expertise in precious stones and his role in refining the Bvlgari aesthetic. He began collaborating with his father in 1960, specializing in the knowledge of stones.

stories.title: Bvlgari Group chairman Paolo Bulgari dies at 89
stories.summary: Paolo Bulgari, the jewelry designer and Bvlgari Group chairman, has died at 89. The company confirmed the news on social media, describing him as a brilliant beacon of creative inspiration. He had led the group since 1984, following in the footsteps of his grandfather, Sotirio Bulgari.

stories.title: Zavya raises Rs 22.6 crore in funding
stories.summary: Everyday silver jewelry brand Zavya has raised Rs 22.6 crore in a pre-Series A round led by Daksham Growth Ventures. The company, which focuses on 925 sterling silver, plans to use the capital to accelerate digital growth and expand its physical retail footprint across India.

stories.title: Stirling woman on how she created a £1m business by ‘telling stories through jewellery’ - The Courier
SK Jewellery releases Malay-language gold guide
stories.summary: Malaysian retailer SK Jewellery has published a Malay-language guide to assist couples in selecting gold for traditional wedding trays. The guide provides information on 916 and 999 gold purity, intended to help families navigate the common practice of exchanging gold jewelry during Malay wedding ceremonies.

stories.title: Call of the Celt , the unending romance of Scottish Victorian jewellery - Financial Times
Safari Industries signs 20-year Carlton licensing deal
stories.summary: Safari Industries has signed a 20-year licensing agreement to sell Carlton luggage in India. The company is targeting the premium segment with a collection that includes aluminium and hybrid luggage, with prices ranging from Rs 6,900 to Rs 21,000. It aims to strengthen its presence in luxury travel.

stories.title: Mokobara launches handbag brand Goose Emergency
stories.summary: Luggage brand Mokobara has entered the fashion market with Goose Emergency, a new label focused on handbags. While the parent company emphasizes functional minimalism, the new brand is positioned around maximalist styling and experimental textures. The collection features eight variations of a single silhouette.

stories.title: Mokobara enters fashion with Goose Emergency
stories.summary: Mokobara has launched Goose Emergency, a fashion brand debuting with a handbag collection called PONZO VOL. 1. The venture marks the company's move into women's fashion, focusing on maximalist designs and bold colors. The brand spent over a year developing its identity online before the official launch.

stories.title: Mokobara enters handbag category with Goose Emergency
Mokobara expands into fashion with Goose Emergency
stories.summary: Mokobara has launched a second brand, Goose Emergency, marking its entry into women-centric fashion. The label debuts with a handbag collection featuring eight interpretations of a single silhouette. The brand describes its aesthetic as luxurious and maximalist, aiming to look beyond current trends.

stories.title: Lenskart Smart Glasses (Phonic): Open-Ear Audio, Bluetooth Calling & Price in India - TechnoSports Media Group
Charles & Keith opens first Jaipur store
stories.summary: Charles & Keith has opened its 25th store in India at Pacific Mall, Jaipur. The 1,347 square foot space features the brand's Concept 7 design. The retailer continues its expansion in the country, positioning itself as a provider of accessible, contemporary fashion designs.

stories.title: Foot Locker opens store in Jaipur
stories.summary: Foot Locker has opened a new outlet at Pacific Mall in Jaipur, marking its latest expansion in the Indian market. The retailer is building its footprint in the country's growing sneaker and sportswear sector, with the project executed by Platear ShopFits to reach new regional customers.

stories.title: Primark opens 49th US store in Virginia
stories.summary: Primark has opened its 49th US store at the Fashion Centre at Pentagon City in Arlington, Virginia. The 18,000 square foot location is the retailer's fifth in the Washington DC area. The company noted the store's proximity to the D.C. Metro system as a convenience for shoppers.

stories.title: Australian hand-made fashion faces a shrinking market
stories.summary: Australian textile and footwear manufacturing jobs have fallen from 115,000 in 1989 to approximately 30,000 in 2026. While mass-market garment production increasingly relies on automation, some local studios continue to offer hand-made services. The warmth of the service reportedly extends beyond the use of an Eftpos machine.

stories.title: Curtain manufacturer promises transparency
stories.summary: A manufacturer of yarn-dyed and printed curtains claims to follow moral business policies and crystal pure transparency in all transactions. The company, which requires a minimum order of 100 pieces, says it directs all activities to cater to the expectations of customers as per their gratification.

stories.title: Polish warehouse stocks teddy fleece fabric
stories.summary: A supplier is offering polyester teddy fleece fabric in eight colors, including Dirty Pink and Apricot. The material is OEKO-TEX certified and available in full rolls of approximately 60 meters from a warehouse in Poland. It is marketed for use in soft toys, cushions, and clothing.

stories.title: Performance jacket supplier offers customization
stories.summary: A manufacturer is offering custom 3D-sculpted longline performance jackets for 17.35 USD per piece. The garment is composed of 70 percent nylon and 30 percent spandex. Buyers can customize logos, fabrics, and colors to meet private-label requirements with a minimum order of 200 pieces.

stories.title: Yoga set supplier targets private-label market
stories.summary: A manufacturer is offering custom sports yoga sets comprising a bra and leggings for 10.00 USD per set. The fabric blend is 82 percent nylon and 18 percent spandex. The company provides private-label services with a minimum order of 200 sets for worldwide export.

stories.title: Yoga leggings supplier highlights naked-feel fabric
stories.summary: A manufacturer is offering private-label high-waisted yoga leggings for 5.15 USD per piece. The product features a no-front-seam design and a soft, naked-feel fabric. The company supports flexible small-batch production and allows for customization of logos, colors, and packaging for global buyers.

stories.title: Fashion Council Germany hosts London craft exhibition
stories.summary: Fashion Council Germany and The King’s Foundation are hosting an exhibition at Garrison Chapel through November 30. The project features five designers using stock materials provided by eBay Germany and the Zerow platform. The exhibition aims to showcase the designers' learning processes and traditional craft techniques.

stories.title: Nigerian designer scales indigenous craft
stories.summary: Gbenga Emmanuel Enikanosaye of Gee Royale Fashion is scaling indigenous Nigerian craft for global markets. The designer, who created a machine chain-stitch embroidery fabric called Minayo Textile, says his work blends cultural storytelling with eco-friendly production to reshape African identity for contemporary buyers.

stories.title: Eco Fashion Week Africa promotes garment reuse
stories.summary: Eco Fashion Week Africa is challenging consumption habits by encouraging the rewear and reinvention of existing clothes. Founders Belinda Atieno and Ruth Anyango recently hosted a No New Clothes runway show in Malindi, where designers transformed old garments into new outfits to avoid the need for new fabric.

stories.title: Governments seek textile circularity policy
stories.summary: Governments have called for a Global Textiles Policy Dialogue to address industry sustainability. The initiative aims to accelerate the shift toward a circular, resource-efficient, and climate-neutral textile sector. The dialogue is intended to foster international policy cooperation among participating nations.

stories.title: Thrifting gains popularity among East Bay teens
stories.summary: Teens in the East Bay are increasingly shopping at consignment stores like Plato’s Closet for vintage clothing. The trend is driven by a desire for savings and sustainability. The movement marks a shift for a generation previously focused on following rapid fashion trends.

stories.title: Mount Gambier diverts seven tonnes of textiles
stories.summary: The City of Mount Gambier diverted over seven tonnes of clothing and textiles from landfill during a recent collection event. Residents delivered 201 vehicle loads to the local waste station. Lifeline collected 2.85 tonnes of reusable items, while 4.48 tonnes were recovered for recycling purposes.

stories.title: TÜV SÜD brings global verification expertise to Higg FEM - Fibre2Fashion
Oritain report finds suppliers embrace traceability and verification - Fibre2Fashion
High tea meets pre-loved fashion in Monbulk - Ferntree Gully Star Mail
Full-fashion knitting market shifts toward efficiency
stories.summary: The market for full-fashion knitting machines is entering a phase of strategic realignment as manufacturers prioritize material efficiency. Systems that produce whole garments in a single operation are being adopted to eliminate cutting and sewing waste. The market enters 2026 with a more regionally diversified supply architecture.

stories.title: Moldovan designer expands wedding dress business
stories.summary: Adela Vasilache, a fashion designer based in Turin, has expanded her wedding dress brand to the Republic of Moldova. After building a career in Italy, she has opened a new studio in Florești. The designer says her work is driven by ambition and perseverance in export markets.

stories.title: India and EU eye December trade deal
stories.summary: India and the European Union are expected to sign a long-awaited Free Trade Agreement during Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s visit to Europe in December. Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal described progress as encouraging, with officials aiming to complete the process before the end of the year.

stories.title: India and EU trade pact nears signing
stories.summary: The India-European Union Free Trade Agreement is likely to be signed during Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit to Europe in December. The move follows the conclusion of negotiations in January. The Prime Minister is expected to conduct a four-nation tour for strategic bilateral and multilateral engagements.

stories.title: India & Canada conclude sixth CEPA talks in New Delhi - Fibre2Fashion
India and Canada conclude sixth round of trade talks
stories.summary: India and Canada have finished the sixth round of negotiations for a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement in New Delhi. The proposed deal aims to reach US$50 billion in bilateral trade by 2030, with both nations seeking to improve market access for farmers, businesses and various industries.

stories.title: India textile exports see September growth
stories.summary: India’s textile and apparel exports rose 17.51 percent to US$3.08 billion in September. Industry representatives attributed the performance to stronger yarn demand and increased overseas sourcing. While the monthly figures showed improvement, cumulative growth for the first half of the fiscal year remains at 2.38 percent.

stories.title: Russian fashion market shifts to local brands
stories.summary: Russian-made goods now account for 52 percent of the domestic fashion market, up from 40 percent in 2023. As local brands replace departed Western chains, the industry ministry aims to reach a 60 percent share. Average margins remain below 5 percent with high borrowing costs.

stories.title: India merchandise exports record broad growth
stories.summary: India’s merchandise exports grew across major global regions between April and September. Africa led with a 44 percent increase, followed by Asia at 21 percent. Engineering, electronics and petroleum products remained primary export categories, reflecting the expanding reach of Indian goods in diverse international markets.

stories.title: Great Britain's retail sales rebound 0.7% in October - Fibre2Fashion
Global Luxury Spending Steady Despite Uncertainty to Bain - Rapaport
Retail Week names top technology partnerships
stories.summary: Retail Week has shortlisted 12 retail technology partnerships for its annual awards. The list includes collaborations between Argos and Mirakl, Waitrose and Satalia, and Boots and Auror. The winning partnership will be announced at the upcoming Retail Week Awards ceremony.

stories.title: Everful secures $48.5 million for factory data platform
stories.summary: Everful, an AI and data infrastructure startup, raised $48.5 million in a Series A round. The company connects retailers with a network of 30,000 factories and manages order delivery. It currently ships five million pieces monthly and is on track to reach $100 million in annualised revenue.

stories.title: On prioritises running shops for Cloudsurfer 3 launch
stories.summary: On opted to supply running shops with the Cloudsurfer 3 before broader distribution. Naperville Running Company reported the model became its top-selling shoe immediately, with the retailer placing weekly replenishment orders to maintain stock levels. The brand appears to have successfully avoided a shortage for its specialist partners.

stories.title: AS Watson automates warehouse operations
stories.summary: AS Watson has doubled productivity at a Dutch distribution centre by implementing new automation technology. The group is overhauling supply chains across 55 global sites to improve delivery speeds. AI has also reduced the time required to compile inter-store stock transfers from six hours to 15 minutes.

stories.title: Taobao uses AI to curate global product range
stories.summary: Taobao is using AI and human curators to select six million products for international shoppers from a catalogue of three billion items. The Taobao Curated Supply System evaluates products based on quality and price. The company maintains that AI alone is not enough for the task.

stories.title: Phia launches AI shopping assistant
stories.summary: Phia has released an AI-powered browser tool and app designed to compare fashion prices across retail and secondhand listings. Co-founded by Phoebe Gates and Sophia Kianni, the platform offers price-drop alerts and automatic coupon application. The company earns revenue through affiliate links on eligible purchases.

stories.title: Lionsgate debuts Hunger Games hologram experience
stories.summary: Lionsgate has launched a hologram experience for The Hunger Games in over 75 US locations. The campaign, created with Hologram Media Network and Pretty Big Monster, will remain in market through November 30. The project is part of a wider push into interactive retail and cinema technology.

stories.title: China adds 34 factories to flagship smart factory list - Fibre2Fashion
Musinsa plans expansion into Thailand
stories.summary: South Korean fashion platform Musinsa will enter Thailand through a partnership with Central Marketing Group. The companies plan to open Musinsa Standard stores to meet rising demand for Korean fashion among younger consumers. A specific timeline for the store openings has not been disclosed.

stories.title: VC funding rebounds as startups raise $255 million
stories.summary: Venture capital funding in Indian startups rose to $255 million this week, up from $26 million the previous week. The increase was supported by deals in the $50 million range across sectors including AI and retail. Large-ticket deals remain limited for now.

stories.title: European tech weekly recap: More than 65 tech funding deals worth over €6B - Tech.eu
Flipkart appoints Amith Fomra as VP of financial planning
stories.summary: Flipkart has appointed Amith Fomra as Vice President of Financial Planning and Analysis. Fomra joins from Walmart, where he served as Vice President of International FP and A. He will partner with finance leaders to support the company enterprise planning and performance management.

stories.title: Kalyan Jewellers in talks to raise Rs 2,000 crore
stories.summary: Kalyan Jewellers is in talks with private equity firms, including former investor Warburg Pincus, to raise Rs 2,000 crore through minority stake sales in its subsidiaries. Warburg Pincus exited the listed retailer in August 2024. The return of an investor is sometimes a reunion.

stories.title: Legend of Toys secures Rs 21 crore in funding
stories.summary: Toy startup Legend of Toys has raised Rs 21 crore in a Pre-Series A round to expand its manufacturing and international presence. The company, which specialises in remote-controlled vehicles, reported an annual recurring revenue of Rs 30 crore. It plans to use the capital for product development.

stories.title: Founders and creators gala to connect AI and fashion
stories.summary: Breakline Society and 99 YARDS are hosting a year-end gala in New York to explore how Physical AI and robotics are reshaping industries. The event aims to connect FashionTech and FinTech founders with venture capitalists and creative leaders. Networking is now an industry of its own.

stories.title: Musinsa Standard is opening 1st store in Malaysia, bringing Korean minimalist fashion to KL
stories.summary: Korean fashion fans, here's another brand to add to your shopping radar. Musinsa Standard, the South Korean label known for its minimalist wardrobe staples and effortlessly put-together looks, is making its way to Malaysia with plans to open its first physical stores in the country. If you've ever found yourself

stories.title: Kazakh fashion brand Adili opens in Hong Kong
stories.summary: Kazakh fashion brand Adili has opened a pop-up flagship store at The Peak in Hong Kong, marking its first international market entry. The store features signature designs and a local capsule collection. The brand was founded in 2010 by sisters Indira and Aigerim Adil.

stories.title: Aussie fashion platform expands to New York
stories.summary: Australian fashion veterans Kelly Atkinson and Richard Poulson have transitioned their WeWearAustralian social media campaign into an omnichannel retail business. The founders have opened a flagship store in New York City to help Australian brands enter international markets. A hashtag has successfully become a storefront.
